title.purpose: The page's single fluid moment, in the head band. One per page.

brand.purpose: The bar wordmark. The one fixed size above body.

card-title.purpose: The feed's headline link, a hair above body so a screen of cards has a scan line.

body.purpose: Every listing surface. Tabular figures throughout, so batch years and salaries align down a column.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-label and key column. Differs from its value by case, weight and colour, never by scale.

mark.purpose: The word beside a status glyph. Uppercase, 700, never wrapping.

fine.purpose: Meta lines, counts, the advertisement marker, legal copy. Never a listing’s facts.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. An open bar menu overlaps content, which is the one place a hairline cannot establish which surface is in front. Derived from Strip Navy at 22%, so depth stays inside the palette.

motion.name: chevron
motion.purpose: A menu chevron rotates when its <details> opens; the in-card arrow nudges 2px on hover. Nothing else transitions — state changes are instant colour and weight swaps. A reduced-motion query clamps everything to 0.01ms.

fonts.note: latin-ext is carried specifically because the rupee sign (U+20B9) lives there; salary lines are unreadable without it. Fallback stack ends in Noto Sans Devanagari so a future Hindi layer does not force a redesign.

guards.name: Contrast Guard
guards.purpose: Quiet text stops at Ink Three, and the binding measurement is the page ground rather than paper. The previous value (#67717b) cleared white at 4.97:1 but fell to 4.39:1 on this ground. A floor checked only against white passes values that fail where the label actually sits.

guards.name: Measured Contrast Floor
guards.measuredAgainst: all 24 foreground/background pairs in the system
guards.purpose: Every pair clears 4.5:1, measured rather than eyeballed. The tightest are the reversed ones: white on WhatsApp green at 5.41:1, white on Telegram blue at 5.74:1, white on Committed Green at 6.63:1, and Bar Light on Lift Navy at 7.36:1. Reversed type is measured against its own ground, quiet ink against the darkest ground it sits on, never against white.

guards.name: One Green, One Meaning
guards.purpose: Committed Green means "this is open, apply here" and appears nowhere else — not as a brand accent, tint or badge fill. The wordmark splits by tone instead of hue for this reason. Navy is chrome and never encodes state.

ceiling.name: Rule weight as an unspent rank axis
ceiling.detail: --rule-strong is used twice (the search control and the scan table header) while a 1px hairline does every other separation job. A graded rule scale is still the axis with the most headroom. Recorded as headroom, not a defect.

ceiling.name: Thumbnail template has one layout
ceiling.detail: Every generated card is banner / role / three fact rows / action bar. A second template — for internships, or for a listing with no salary — would let the drawing respond to what the row actually contains. Deliberately not built in this run.

narrative.overview: The Indian fresher-jobs feed this audience already reads daily — navy bar of category menus, a column of thumbnail cards, a sidebar of what closes next — built honestly. The format's central promise is that you can judge your eligibility before clicking, and it normally holds only for the postings someone had time to draw a card for. Here the card is rendered from the row's own columns, so it holds for every listing.
keyCharacteristics: Every listing has a generated thumbnail; there is no "no image" state to design around.
One green, one meaning. Navy is chrome, grey is ground, green is the only colour that carries information.
Status is a drawn glyph plus a word; colour never carries meaning alone.
Content always sits on paper; the navy never touches body text.
Ad heights reserved up front; never above the first content block.
All 24 foreground/background pairs clear 4.5:1 — measured, not eyeballed.
Zero JavaScript ships. Archivo self-hosted as two woff2 subsets.
rules: One Green, One Meaning — #0b6b35 says "this is open, apply here". A green anywhere else is a bug.
Chrome Says Nothing — navy is structure. The moment navy encodes state, the reader has two colour systems to learn.
Content On Paper — body text never sits on the page ground or on navy.
The Contrast Guard — quiet ink is measured against the page ground, reversed type against its own ground, never against white.
Rank By Weight, Not Scale — four sizes exist and three appear once per page.
Cards, Not Boxes-In-Boxes — nothing nests a bordered panel inside another bordered panel.
Never Above The First Block — no ad precedes the first content block, so an ad can never be the LCP element.
One Shadow, One Reason — depth resolves overlap only, never decorates a resting surface.
dos: Generate the thumbnail from the listing's columns; never require a hand-made asset.
Keep green for "open / apply here" and nothing else.
Pair every status colour with a glyph and a word.
Put body content on paper, always.
Measure quiet ink against the page ground, not white.
Let the thumbnail keep its aspect ratio and centre it; do not stretch it to card height.
Reserve ad height before the script exists.
Keep the menus working with JavaScript disabled.
donts: Use green as a brand accent, a tint, or a badge fill.
Add a shadow to a resting surface.
Place an ad above the first content block, or enable Auto Ads.
Introduce a fifth type size to create hierarchy — use weight, case and colour.
Ship a channel button whose URL is not configured.
